content.text: Insert SST against the shaft, and turn it clockwise while pressing in the remover.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being inserted against shaft to remove shaft seal from compressor, with inset showing detailed view of seal location

items: (a) Using SST, remove the bolts holding the two service valves.
(b) Remove the O-rings from the service valves and discard them.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to remove bolts from service valves on compressor
Illustration showing compressor being tilted to drain oil into a container

content.text: (a) Using SST, remove the six through bolts.
NOTE: Do not reuse the six washers.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to remove six through bolts from compressor housing

content.text: (b) Using a hammer and punch, remove the front housing by tapping on the protrusion.
CAUTION: Be careful not to scratch the sealing surface of the front housing.

content.description: Illustration showing hammer and punch being used to tap on protrusion to remove front housing from compressor
